_meta.description: Event-to-agent delegation map consumed by orchestrator.py. Each key is a game event; the value is the agent responsible for handling it. The bus.py router uses this map to dispatch messages.

events.turn_start: Fires at the beginning of each turn before any action is taken
events.after_hand_analysis: Fires after hand_analyst returns its hand evaluation payload
events.on_trigger: Fires when a conditional game rule or ability is activated
events.on_opponent_play: Fires when the opponent takes a visible action (card play, attack, ability)
events.always: Runs every tick regardless of event — used for time-budget enforcement
